runtimeVariantClusters.summary: Azure realtime speech-to-speech teacher over WebRTC, with ephemeral client secrets and a cascade fallback on quota or reconnection failure.
Child microphone to Azure realtime transcription, server-side lesson turn, then framed streaming TTS with PCM, clause and viseme events.
The same lesson runtime and guarded server-authored turn path without microphone input; optional streamed read-aloud shares the TTS pipeline.
Configuration switch across Azure Speech DragonHD, Preview MAI voice behind an explicit gate, and Azure OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts; sticky failure handling prevents per-sentence oscillation.

hinglishEnglish.notes: STT accepts Hindi, English and mixed speech. Spoken rendering is language- and school-medium-aware. Optional Roman-Hinglish to Devanagari conversion is deterministic and skips English lanes and safety text.

lessonOrchestration.notes: The HTTP route is thin; server/brain/turn.js performs perception, safety, speculative reply, deterministic planning, Studio arbitration, guarded wording, state staging and one-transaction persistence.

modelRouting.notes: Role names route to deployments, endpoint lanes can use different Azure accounts, and hot/background calls have separate quota treatment. This is not a multi-vendor key pool.

freeGeminiKeysOrProviderPools.notes: Gemini occurs in research/reference material and once in an AI-identity phrase detector at server/relational/lexicon/en.js:96. The model-router document marks Gemini as experiment-only and states product models are Azure-billed. Azure WebSocket connection pooling at server/voice/azureTtsWs.js:139-173 is a transport pool, not a key pool. No credential values were read or recorded.

rankedReusableCode.reason: Centralizes lane/account selection, prevents cross-account key fallback, and returns only matching ephemeral hosts.
Protects live calls from background evaluation and content-generation load with measured sliding-window limits and 429 pauses.
Carries PCM, clause timing, visemes and turn metadata over one backpressure-aware response while preserving an unframed compatibility path.

rankedReusableCode.reason: Useful cache, first-byte, socket-pool, abort and identity-stability patterns, but Taxila's child/lesson persistence must be replaced with the destination product's contracts.
Deterministic language-aware number, notation, helpline and Roman-Hindi rendering is directly relevant to Indian voice agents.
Explicit quota detection, one retry, lane switch, re-voice semantics and duplicate-resistant continuation are reusable reliability ideas.
The separation of code-owned policy, model perception/wording, safety floor, speculative work and atomic persistence is strong, but the implementation is tightly bound to child tutoring schemas.
